paragraphs: Rabbi Hillel, son of Rabbi Vallas (see his entry); some say Rabbah, Rava’s son: Avodah Zarah 52b; Sanhedrin 36a; Gittin 59a. Rabbi Yose—it appears it should read Rabbi Yisa, who is Rabbi Assi—and Rabbi Yonah, in Rabbi Chiyya bar Va’s name: they found written in Rabbi Hillel bar Alas’s notebook, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Kilayim; end of chapter 2: Vallas. Rabbi Hillel bar Vallas had a garment worth 300,000 dinars and gave it to Rabbi; he found mixed fibers in it and burned it, there,chapter 9. In Challah chapter 1,halakhah 4: Rabbi Hillel bar Hallis. Bar Vallas asked before Rabbi: end of chapter Haomer. In chapter Mashilin: Rabbi Lil, son of Rabbi Alam.
